table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale'   else item.name end, 
	aliasname=max(item.customicode),
	users.username,  
	reprintdate=getdate(),
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	posted=max(saleledger.posted),
	balance=isnull(max(balance),0),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	dbo.saleledger.date,  
	messagedesc=max(message.description) ,
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
	dbo.saledetail.icode,   
	dbo.saledetail.gcode, 
	Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
	packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice), 
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
	discperc  = max(saledetail.discperc), 
	customername=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=saleledger.custcode)  ,
	itemflatdisc  = max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
	unitsalestax  = max(saledetail.unitsalestax),
	gstperc       = max(saledetail.gstperc),
	invgstperc    = max(saleledger.invgstperc1),
	reprintcounter=max(saleledger.reprintingcounter),
	doctor=max(doctors.name),
	patient=max(patient.name)

FROM 
	dbo.saleledger
	LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.Message ON (dbo.saleledger.MessageCode = dbo.Message.MessageCode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.Doctors ON (dbo.saleledger.doctcode = dbo.Doctors.doctcode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.Patient ON (dbo.saleledger.Patientcode = dbo.Patient.Patientcode),
	dbo.saledetail,  
	item,
	Users
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( saleLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode )
GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	saleledger.date, 
	saleledger.custcode, 
	saleledger.discperc, 
	saleledger.flatdisc, 
	saleledger.misccharges, 
	saleledger.headerno,
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.remarks, 
	saledetail.icode,
	saledetail.rowgroup,  
	saledetail.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable,
	users.username
ORDER BY 
	MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: c_sumitemleveltaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: compute_16
objects.expression: sum( saledetail_saleprice *looseqty for all)  - ( (sum( saledetail_saleprice *looseqty for all)*0.01* saleledger_discperc + sum(looseqty* itemflatdisc )) )

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: Round(sum( saledetail_saleprice *looseqty for all)+ saleledger_misccharges  - ( saleledger_flatdisc + (sum( saledetail_saleprice *looseqty for all)*0.01* saleledger_discperc + sum(looseqty* itemflatdisc )) ),0)
